column6: @note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a1]{6.1.09.a1}, @xref[t.6.2.5,]{6.2.5: IM43438 Seg. A l. 1}} Whatever the man in authority said, it was not pleasant.
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a2]{6.1.09.a2}} Whatever the man in authority said, it was not right.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a3]{6.1.09.a3}, @xref[t.6.2.2,t622.h5]{6.2.2: MDP 27 216}, @xref[t.6.2.5,]{6.2.5: IM 43438 Seg. A l. 2}} When the authorities are wise, and the poor are loyal, it is the effect of the blessing of @wSN{Aratta}.
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a5]{6.1.09.a5}} It is from a man's mouth that strength comes.
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a6]{6.1.09.a6}, @xref[t.6.2.3,t623.h65]{6.2.3: UET 6/3 462}} Strength cannot keep pace with intelligence.
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a7]{6.1.09.a7}} The strength of my god completes my own.
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.09,t.6.1.09.a8]{6.1.09.a8}, @xref[t.6.1.17,t.6.1.17.b3]{6.1.17.b3}, @xref[t.6.1.17,]{ll. 12-13}, 5.6.7: l. 28} Youthful vigour has left my loins, like a runaway donkey.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.17,t.6.1.17.b3]{6.1.17.b3}, @xref[t.6.1.17,]{l. 15}, @xref[t.6.1.19,t.6.1.19.a1]{6.1.19.a1}, @xref[t.6.1.19,]{ll. 2-3}, 5.6.7: l. 30} My mother sent to me a man from the forest, who has given me paralysed hands.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.17,t.6.1.17.b3]{6.1.17.b3}, @xref[t.6.1.17,]{ll. 16-17}, @xref[t.6.1.19,t.6.1.19.a1]{6.1.19.a1}, @xref[t.6.1.19,]{ll. 4-5}, 5.6.7: l. 31} My mongoose, which used to eat strong-smelling @varh[t6110.v1]{food } @vart[t6110.v2,]{@note{1 ms. has instead:} meat }, can no longer stretch its neck toward a jar of ghee.
@q{“The lap three times, the eye seven times”} is what she says to the one about to breach her defences.
